newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- KPN calls feature in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- KPN calls feature in thin trade.

text.p: Trading was subdued again on the European Options Exchange on Monday, reflecting the lack of direction in the underlying market, dealers said.
KPN options were most in demand, with calls dominating puts as investors jumped on the Telecoms bandwagon in the afterglow of BT's announced mega-merger with the U.S.'s MCI.
KPN options make up 18.05 percent of all contracts traded, wityh 9,525 calls and 2,274 puts going through by 1515 GMT.
Index options provide most of the rest of the focus, making up 15.60 perecnt of total volume. Puts beat calls by 6,280 to 3,928. Overall volume thin at around 65,500.
